Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the specific death location from the Wikipedia page despite the page content explicitly stating that Walton "set up home with his young wife Susana on the Italian island of Ischia" and the infobox showing "29 March 1902 - 8 March 1983". Instead of synthesizing this clear information or noting the discrepancy between the visible text and the lack of an explicit "Died in..." line in the viewport, the agent continued to loop through redundant searches (revisiting Britannica multiple times) without successfully gathering the required corroborating evidence from the Wikipedia source as instructed. This led to an inefficient process where the agent relied heavily on repeated Britannica checks rather than utilizing the successfully loaded Wikipedia data to confirm the death location.
